source.title: Dubai's Golden Visa scheme rewards outstanding educators on World Teachers' Day
source.text: Hundreds of educators across private schools and universities in Dubai are benefiting from a Golden Visa drive recognising exceptional teaching. The annual programme, which was launched under the directive of Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed, Crown Prince of Dubai, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defence, grants long-term residency to high-performing teachers and educators working in private early-childhood centres, schools and higher-education institutions. Since its launch on October 5, 2024, to coincide with World Teachers' Day, the visa initiative has attracted more than 835 applicants. Candidates are assessed through a comprehensive professional evaluation that considers academic qualifications, outstanding achievements, contributions to the education sector and wider community, and positive feedback from parents, pupils and students. The scheme forms part of Dubai's Education 33 strategy, which aims to attract and retain skilled teachers, tutors and lecturers whose expertise strengthens students and pupils' learning experiences and bolsters the emirate's regional and international competitiveness. To be eligible, applicants must work in a private educational institution and demonstrate outstanding academic achievements or creative contributions to education, a proven record of improving educational quality and a tangible positive effect within learning. Significant contributions to improving student outcomes – including academic progress and the attainment of accredited qualifications – are also among the criteria. Further details on eligibility requirements and the application process are available on the Knowledge and Human Development Authority website.

bad_post: В Дубае выдающимся педагогам присваивают Золотую визу В Дубае стартовала программа выдачи Золотой визы для высококвалифицированных педагогов частных детских садов, школ и вузов. Инициатива, запущенная 5 октября 2026 года в День учителя, направлена на поощрение выдающихся достижений и вкладов в образование. За время действия программы подано более 835 заявок, а кандидаты проходят комплексную оценку по академическим заслугам, достижениям и отзывам учеников и родителей. Программа входит в стратегию Education 33, направленную на привлечение и удержание талантливых педагогов в эмирате.

bad_review.reason: The post contains multiple factual inaccuracies and date inconsistencies compared to the source. The source states the Golden Visa scheme was launched on October 5, 2024, but the post claims it started on October 5, 2026. The source specifies the scheme is for educators in private early-childhood centres, schools, and higher-education institutions, not 'детских садов' (kindergartens) specifically. The post's headline and claims about the program's purpose and application numbers are mostly supported, but the date error and slight scope mismatch cause rejection.

emoji_verdicts.reason: The emoji relates to education and is appropriate for the paragraph about educators and the Golden Visa program.
